product_findings.acceptance: Feature spec includes a concrete journey with deterministic completion and error-state expectations.
product_findings.action: Add explicit user journey steps for this feature (entry, critical action, completion, and failure behavior).
product_findings.spec_guidance: Describe the user journey for this feature including entry point, completion state, and error path expectation.
product_findings.title: User journey details are missing

product_findings.acceptance: Acceptance criteria include measurable checks that can be validated without subjective interpretation.
product_findings.action: Add measurable acceptance criteria for this feature with deterministic observable outputs/evidence.
product_findings.spec_guidance: Define measurable acceptance outcomes for this feature so completion can be verified objectively.
product_findings.title: Acceptance criteria are not measurable

security_findings.acceptance: Feature docs and tests include at least one denied-path scenario proving unauthorized access is blocked.
security_findings.action: Add explicit authN/authZ requirements and denied-path behavior for this feature where privileged actions are possible.
security_findings.spec_guidance: Document required authorization expectations and denied-path behavior for feature actions that can change protected state.
security_findings.title: Access-control expectations are missing for feature scope

security_findings.acceptance: Validation evidence proves sensitive tokens are masked in feature-generated logs/offload artifacts.
security_findings.action: Define and enforce redaction/masking rules before feature-owned log or offload writes, and add regression coverage with synthetic secret values.
security_findings.spec_guidance: If this feature writes logs/offload/output artifacts, define redaction rules for secrets and sensitive tokens.
security_findings.title: Sensitive-data redaction is undefined for feature logging/output

security_findings.acceptance: Tests include traversal/absolute-path attempts and verify the feature fails closed without writing outside allowed roots.
security_findings.action: Add explicit path-safety rules (allowlist + canonical containment checks) for feature file paths and cover traversal attempts in tests.
security_findings.spec_guidance: Where feature behavior constructs file paths, define canonicalization, containment checks, and traversal rejection.
security_findings.title: Path-safety constraints are missing for feature file operations
